information.description:
Mini Air Drone. A mini air drone, 200m from your Neuroport, 24 hours a charge. Cloaks as an Action (DV21 Perception). Camera with Anti-Dazzle, Image Enhance, LL/IR/UV, MicroVideo and TeleOptics. Modes: Standby, Direct Control (from your Neuroport), Scout (flies a route up to 1km away, records 5 minutes, comes back).

Cost: 5,000eb
MOVE: 4
HP: 10
CN: 10
Counter: DV17 E/S Tech, 5 min to counter

Item Compendium (2070) • Gear & Goods

Art: Neon Hub fan art of the Cyberpunk 2077 setting (CD PROJEKT RED), free to use, not for sale.
information.notes:
Threat: Drone • CN: 10

CN (Combat Number) is the base of its attacks, Evasion and Perception.
